feedback_app_has_message.name: feedback_app_has_message
feedback_app_has_message.value: "feedback"."kind" <> 'app' OR ("feedback"."message" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("feedback"."message")) > 0)

feedback_forecast_is_complete.name: feedback_forecast_is_complete
feedback_forecast_is_complete.value: "feedback"."kind" <> 'forecast' OR ("feedback"."observed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback"."observed_conditions" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback"."verdict" IS NOT NULL)
